description: First iteration: keep Saval car-following values, lower red-running and set small early-start and space-seeking probabilities from the observed shares.

driver_archetypes.rationale: Targets M1/car discharge headway and M6 car approach times; Saval et al. Table 11 car values kept unchanged because no feedback yet shows a car-following mismatch.
Car violators that may seek space; same car-following as car_saval so M1/car and M6 car times stay unchanged. Share 0.1 kept: observed M9a (0.33 veh/cycle) is small, so few seekers suffice.
Targets M1/moto headway (0.30 s) and M4/M5 queue density; Saval motorcycle values kept, minGapLat at lower bound 0.3 m for dense packing in the queue.
Motorcycle violators that may use sidewalk or right-turn lane (M10a 0.27 veh/cycle, M9a); same riding values as moto_saval so only the seeking rule differs. Share 0.1 kept.
Illegal-left riders; jmTimegapMinor kept at 1.0 s until feedback on M7a/M7b release times shows a direction, to change one thing at a time.

traci_rules.rationale: Targets M3/share/moto (observed 0.092) and M3/per_cycle (4.4 veh/cycle): the literature 0.5 per front-row rider overshoots a per-vehicle share of 0.09, so p0 is lowered to 0.2 (front-row only, many riders are not in the front row); k = 0 since M3/var_to_mean 1.31 is near Poisson, i.e. little swarm clustering.

Targets M2/early/moto (observed 0.13 share in the last 10 s of red) and M2/first_delay (2.1 s): front-row creep with p = 0.25 gives a share of this size among all riders, window 8 s lies within the 4-10 s lead time, v_max 2 m/s keeps it a creep.

Targets F2/p/right_lane (0.006-0.031), F2/p/sidewalk (0.005-0.016), M9a (0.33 veh/cycle), M10a (0.27 veh/cycle) and the choice queue of about 13 m (M9c, M10b): trigger q = 15 m so seeking starts at the observed queue length, small probabilities 0.03 and 0.02 match the observed shares. p_wrong_lane stays 0 because it is inapplicable on the proxy net (R27).
